This is more of like an introspective post.

I just realized that I've been waking up each day to get ready for a job that I don't like going to for the past 3 years. Not to say it's not paying my bills, I am grateful that I have more resources than those who are more unfortunate living in the streets. The only thing that's bothering me at my soul is having to listen to someone how to live my life, and that's called having a J.O.B. (Just Obey your Boss)

Well that realization hit me when I tried waking up in the morning today for the opening of the New York Session. My alarm woke up, several times. I hit the snooze button several times and went back to sleep right away. It was hard getting up.

That made me question my own desire to succeed.

Do I really want this trading career? The answer is a big YES with out a doubt.

Does it hurt enough for me to really step up my game? The answer if probably no at the subconscious level.

Do I need to go through that route of intolerable pain for me to get out of my own way and be willing to sacrifice a few little things that matter? My answer is no.

What am I doing then? Cold truth of reality is. I got to push HARDER. To give a hard sickening work ethic to where I want to be as if TRADING IS THE ONLY WAY. Like there's no plan B. To invest efficient time and energy to my learning until I get there. To commit my self on discipline and education until RESULTS SHOW UP in front of me. To really live by the words of "IT'S NOT OVER UNTIL I WIN!"

I see now that it was hard waking up in the morning. I also see now that it's harder being here at work, succumb to having only 30 minutes of break time every 4 hours. Man I see now that to be a successful trader, I got to get on a whole another level of beliefs, thinking, and everyday actions, than being an employee.
